identity.name: Inspector Han
identity.origin: Original supporting character in Jasmine After Rain, not Avatar franchise canon
identity.location: Ba Sing Se municipal sanitation service

biography.established: Arrives expecting preferential treatment; demands records and completes a real inspection; finds issues that still require correction.
biography.unwritten: His superiors, motives beyond observed status-seeking, and family are not established.

personality.voice: Title-forward, curt and procedural when convenient
personality.flaws: Mistakes public authority for personal entitlement
personality.strengths: Technical concerns must not be dismissed merely because his manners are poor

agency: He can issue legitimate findings, subject to protocol, without being transformed into a caricature or allowed to abuse staff.
boundary: Story-grounded original. No external canon or invented backstory.
